game.rules:
General Rules:

- Upon reaching the credits, your game must be in a state where the "The End" screen can be reached. This means that you DO NOT have to get to the "The End" screen for the run to be valid, but your game has to be in a state where you CAN reach that screen.
- Timing starts on file select (specifically, the frame that the cursor on "Yes" disappears).
- Timing ends as soon as Majora's Wrath is damaged for the final time, starting the ending cutscene or on the first frame of the ending cutscene in the case of credits warps.
- Secondary files created that affect the file intended to be completed must be included in the timing of the speedrun.
- All runs that involve Bombers' code, Oceanside Spider House code, or lottery code must begin using newly created files; this includes 100% runs. Runs of categories not involving these codes can start from new file, but if desired, can also be started from an existing file so long as the file has no progress and is functionally identical to a new file.
- Modifying the control stick of a controller in any intentional way, including notch carving, for the sake of getting "better diagonals" or an angle that is impossible to just as easily obtain on an official, unmodified controller is banned. 
- Macros, including the use of turbo functions, is banned.
- Controller modification of digital inputs, including the removal of a GameCube controller's triggers' springs, is allowed (assuming the modification does not result in an analog output).
- Part replacement is acceptable, including swapping out a GameCube controller's control stick for a Wii nunchuk's control stick.
- Controller adapters are permitted. The following rules apply:
-   Analog stick mappings that decrease the difficulty of holding the ESS position relative to official, unmodified 
controllers on that console are prohibited (with the exceptions of extremely minor changes to ESS position and changes made to the deadzone (such as Raphnets)).
-   Any adapters used may not map analog stick inputs to buttons (mapping the C-stick to the C-buttons is fine).
-   Notch calibration, and therefore adapters that expressly calibrate notches, are allowed.
- Use of Restore Points and Savestates is banned (this rule is excluded for setting up Individual Level runs).
- Emulators are allowed. The allowed emulators include Project64, Mupen64Plus and Dolphin. You must play on official hardware if you reach less than 15% of the world record. All emulators must be on the latest build with default settings, with the exception of very specific settings on Dolphin, as follows:
    - Changing the Backend to Direct3D/DirectX for Windows, Vulkan for Linux, or Metal for MacOS.
    - Changing the Adapter to the most powerful graphics device on your PC.
    - Checking "Skip EFB Access from CPU"
    - Unchecking "Store EFB Copies to Texture Only"
    - Changing the Fallback Region to NTSC-U or NTSC-J.
    - Changing the CPU Overclock setting to 125% (This fixes a sound glitch that can occur)
- EverDrive is allowed. However, it must be on v2.5, v3, or x7 and run the rom via the auto-boot function. There is no cap.
- 64Drive is allowed. However, if you reach the world record within less than 1%, you must play on official hardware.
- Nintendont is banned for all submissions.

-   Analog stick mappings that decrease the difficulty of holding the ESS position relative to official, unmodified 
controllers on that console are prohibited (with the exceptions of extremely minor changes to ESS position and changes made to the deadzone (such as Raphnets)).
-   Any adapters used may not map analog stick inputs to buttons (mapping the C-stick to the C-buttons is fine).
-   Notch calibration, and therefore adapters that expressly calibrate notches, are allowed.
- Use of Restore Points and Savestates is banned (this rule is excluded for setting up Individual Level runs).
- Emulators are allowed. The allowed emulators include Project64, Mupen64Plus and Dolphin. You must play on official hardware if you reach less than 15% of the world record. All emulators must be on the latest build with default settings, with the exception of very specific settings on Dolphin, as follows:
    - Changing the Backend to Direct3D/DirectX for Windows, Vulkan for Linux, or Metal for MacOS.
    - Changing the Adapter to the most powerful graphics device on your PC.
    - Checking "Skip EFB Access from CPU"
    - Unchecking "Store EFB Copies to Texture Only"
    - Changing the Fallback Region to NTSC-U or NTSC-J.
    - Changing the CPU Overclock setting to 125% (This fixes a sound glitch that can occur)
- EverDrive is allowed. However, it must be on v2.5, v3, or x7 and run the rom via the auto-boot function. There is no cap.
- 64Drive is allowed. However, if you reach the world record within less than 1%, you must play on official hardware.
- Nintendont is banned for all submissions.
